fields.name: PgParameterCollectionExtensions materialized Npgsql parameter
fields.description: The parameter record PgParameterCollectionExtensions appends to a DbParameterCollection for a Query contract. The AddPg*Parameter member selected fixes its PostgreSQL type and direction, which determine whether it carries an input value or reserves an output value; size, precision, scale, and element type are supplied only by the applicable type families.

members.name: name
members.description: The caller-supplied parameter name, used exactly as given: PgParameterCollectionExtensions.NormalizePgParameterName deliberately returns it unchanged, so no ':' (or '@') prefix is added and casing is not changed.

members.name: direction
members.description: Input for value-bearing (AddPg*InputParameter) members, which send a supplied value; output for retrieval (AddPg*OutputParameter) members, which reserve a returned value.

members.name: postgresType
members.description: The Npgsql PostgreSQL type selected by the AddPg*Parameter member: one of Varchar, Char, Text, Bigint, Integer, Smallint, InternalChar, Boolean, Numeric, Money, Double, Real, Timestamp, TimestampTz, Date, Time, Interval, TimeTz, Array, Bytea, Hstore, or Uuid.

members.name: value
members.description: The supplied typed input value, or System.DBNull.Value for an absent nullable or reference input (and, by design, for NaN on the non-nullable Double/Real overloads and Guid.Empty on the non-nullable Uuid overload); output parameters do not receive an input value.

members.name: size
members.description: The declared length for applicable Varchar, Char, and sized Bytea variants.

members.name: precision
members.description: The declared decimal precision for Numeric variants.

members.name: scale
members.description: The declared decimal scale for Numeric variants.

members.name: elementPostgresType
members.description: The array element PostgreSQL type, required by Array variants: one of the non-Array types listed for postgresType.

representations.C#: NpgsqlParameter or NpgsqlParameter<T> appended to DbParameterCollection; Direction maps to ParameterDirection.Input or ParameterDirection.Output.
representations.PostgreSQL: postgresType is selected from the helper family; Array combines NpgsqlDbType.Array with its element type.
